subject: Orchid Conference — package benefits, on-site deliverables & keynote slot request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@orchidconf.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Grant Holloway <grant@orchidconf.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood — 2027 Orchid sponsor package (initial proposal)

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the quick call last week — great to hear Redwood is looking to increase its visibility at Orchid this September. Attached is our updated sponsor package (v3) with a recommended activation plan for a premium booth + keynote. Highlights:

- Premium exhibitor island (3x3 demo pod + lounge) in Hall B (near main stage)
- 20-minute keynote slot on Day 2 (prime afternoon keynote window) — subject to exec confirmation
- Logo placement: main stage backdrop, website hero carousel, printed lanyard tier (optional add-on)
- 2 x 90-minute workshop rooms (co-branded) — available as add-on
- 2000 guaranteed impressions on our attendee app banner and 3 sponsored push notifications during the week

We can hold the keynote slot for you for 5 business days. If you want to proceed we'll send a SOW and DocuSign for signature and begin floorplan allocation.

Attachment: Orchid_Sponsor_Pkg_v3.pdf (pdf)

Quick question: do you need booth staff badges included (we have an early-bird allotment) and are you planning any product demos that require additional AV beyond the tabletop kit?

Best,
Samantha
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Orchid Conference

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@orchidconf.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood — 2027 Orchid sponsor package (initial proposal)

Samantha — thanks for sending this over. A few clarifications so we can go to internal approval: 

1) Keynote timing: can you confirm whether the Day 2 afternoon keynote is 2:00–2:20pm or 3:00–3:20pm? We have a potential speaker who prefers the earlier slot.
2) Logo placement: exactly which tier includes printed lanyards and which tier includes the hero carousel? We want hero carousel and at least secondary stage backdrop.
3) AV and demos: we will likely run a 30 minute live demo and two 10-minute micro-demos per day. Please confirm whether the standard tabletop AV (monitor + HDMI) supports this or if we need dedicated AV cart time.
4) Badges: include 6 staff badges in the package and list pricing for additional badges.

If you can also include an updated site map with proposed booth placement (Hall B adjacency matters for demo traffic) that would help. Holding the keynote slot for 5 days works for us while we confirm the speaker.

Thanks,
MichaeI Grant
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@orchidconf.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Grant Holloway <grant@orchidconf.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood — 2027 Orchid sponsor package (initial proposal)

Hi Michael,

Quick answers below and attached a draft site map with our suggested island placement next to the main demo corridor (see annotation).

1) Keynote timing: the two available windows are 2:00–2:20pm (preferred by the program committee) and 4:00–4:20pm. We can tentatively hold 2:00–2:20pm — if your speaker prefers the earlier option that aligns.
2) Logo tiers: hero carousel + website hero are part of the Gold tier; printed lanyards are a separate visibility add-on. Main stage backdrop (secondary logo) will be included in the Platinum package. We propose upgrading you to Gold+ (hero + website) and add a printed-lanyard option at discount.
3) AV: standard tabletop kit includes a 24" monitor, HDMI, and power. For live demos at scale we recommend booking the AV cart (includes laptop feed, in-booth mic, 55" monitor) — we can provision two 60-minute AV cart slots per day for an additional fee.
4) Staff badges: package includes 6; additional staff badges are $95 each.

Attachment: SiteMap_HallB-2027.png (png)

If you want I can produce a short SOW showing benefits and install/on-site timelines; we can then move to SOW + DocuSign to lock the keynote.

Regards,
Samantha

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@orchidconf.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood — 2027 Orchid sponsor package (initial proposal)

Thanks Samantha — that helps. Internal notes below (copying Kim and Lauren to confirm budget/creative ops):

- Keynote: tentative yes for 2:00–2:20pm. Speaker: Redwood CEO (pending calendar). Can we get a 15 minute speaker prep/backstage window immediately prior to the keynote? We also need 3 mic passes for stage + 1 lav.
- Logo: Gold+ with discounted lanyard add-on sounds right — please include exact dimensions/placement for the hero carousel and lanyard art specs.
- AV: we'll take the AV cart add-on for two 60-minute slots/day. Please price it and include labor contact details for the AV vendor (lead time typically 6 weeks).
- SOW: yes please — we need a one-page SOW that lists deliverables, cancellation terms, timeline for logos/art assets (we typically supply hi-res SVGs two months out).

Next steps: Kim and Lauren, can you confirm we have budgeted $55k gross for this sponsorship (including lanyard add-on + AV) or do we need to revise? Aditya — please coordinate speaker availability and confirm whether CEO can commit to that 2:00 slot.

Thanks,
Michael

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@orchidconf.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood — 2027 Orchid sponsor package (initial proposal)

Michael / team / Samantha — quick update from finance and creative:

- Finance: $55k is approved as long as Orchid provides a clause in the SOW guaranteeing the keynote window and a substitution policy that requires notice 30 days prior to show; otherwise we need a partial refund if the slot is changed. Please include payment milestones: 50% on signature, 25% 60 days prior, 25% on delivery.
- Creative ops: we can deliver hero carousel art and lanyard SVGs by July 1 if Orchid confirms final placement and provides the exact specs and bleed requirements by May 15.
- AV: confirm the AV vendor will provide an equipment rider and contact; we will accept a labor fee but need an estimate by April 15 to finalize budget.

Samantha — can you send a 1-page SOW with the logo dimensions, keynote hold language (slot & prep window), and a draft payment schedule? If we have that, finance will route the PO and we can execute DocuSign within 5 business days.

Best,
Kimberly Park
VP, Demand Generation
Redwood Inference
